body:
CHANGELOG updated in ECOWAR: Mandelbrot procedural jungle generation (S370): 32-piece hand-placed obstacle layout stays exactly as-is; 96 new procedurally-generated trees/rocks (ARENA_OBSTACLE_COUNT 32->128) fill the space between bases via Mandelbrot escape-time boundary sampling, seeded fresh per match (isolated xorshift32 PRNG, not libc rand()) so client and server independently compute the identical layout with no wire sync, matching the founder's 'procedurally generate the map for each new game' ask. Real gaps found and fixed along the way, not assumed: ECOWAR's own matchmaker/server never actually had the seed-plumbing protocol.h's own comment described (MatchFoundMsg was pre-DUNGEON_NORTHSTAR, no seed field at all, no --seed argv anywhere) -- built for real: matchmaker generates + passes --seed to the spawned server and MatchFoundMsg.seed to every client, also fixed a pre-existing uninitialized-stack-garbage bug in that same message. Exclusion zones (nodes/graveyards/shops/fountains/camps/other obstacles) keep every base, lane, and objective clear. ArenaSnapshotMsg's obstacle_hp[] split into its own PACKET_ARENA_SNAPSHOT_OBSTACLES packet (same MTU-fragmentation precedent as the earlier hero-chunk split) since 128 obstacles would have reopened that budget. New tests/test_procedural_jungle.c: exclusion-zone, determinism, and per-seed-variety checks. Live-verified end to end with a throwaway matchmaker+server+client round trip (seed generated, matched identically on both received MatchFoundMsg copies, server accepted --seed and started clean) -- production ecowar-matchmaker.service NOT restarted, still running the pre-change binary until a deploy is explicitly requested. bash scripts/build.sh + bash scripts/test_arena.sh both clean (3138 PASS, 0 FAIL). (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
